title: On $r$-cross $t$-intersecting families of partitions
summary: In this paper, we address several intersection problems for $r$-cross $t$-intersecting families of partitions. A $k$-partition of an $n$-set $X$ is a set of $k$ pairwise disjoint non-empty subsets whose union is $X$. For $1\leq i\leq r$, let $\mathcal{F}_i$ be a family of $k_i$-partitions of $X$. We say that $\mathcal{F}_1,\mathcal{F}_2,\ldots,\mathcal{F}_r$ are $r$-cross $t$-intersecting if $|\cap_{i=1}^{r}F_i|\geq t$ for all $F_i\in\mathcal{F}_i$.
